text:
**Meet Rowbase: Turn Your Spreadsheets Into APIs in Seconds**

Rowbase launched on March 4, 2026. It turns your CSV files into live, queryable APIs with no setup.

Upload a file and Rowbase generates a documented API endpoint your apps can use right away. It supports five file formats, so your existing data should work as it is.

The free tier includes 1,000 requests per day, enough to build, test, and ship without paying.

212 beta users shaped Rowbase with their feedback, and we're grateful to every one of them for sticking with us from the start.

Head to rowbase.dev and drop in your first CSV. We can't wait to see what you build.
